done_when: This repo's forge.toml sets workers = "claude" and [models.build], [models.fix] and [models.lite] to claude-opus-5-5 at medium effort without subagents; review stays on Codex; forge doctor passes

findings.body: `src/forge/ask.py:25-31` starts a Codex conversation, and `src/forge/codex.py:132-138` selects `[models.lite]` for Ask. A normal `forge ask` therefore sends `claude-opus-5-5` to Codex. The committed `.codex/config.toml` supplies no custom provider, and the [Codex configuration reference](https://developers.openai.com/ja-JP/docs/config-file/config-reference) specifies OpenAI as the default provider. Give Ask a Codex-compatible default or route it through Claude.
findings.title: Keep `forge ask` from sending the Claude lite model to Codex

why: The owner moved this repo's workers from Codex to Claude on Opus 5.5 at medium effort, keeping Autoreview on Codex
